note: Rules for which model ids name the SAME model, and which lab made a model, for review independence (review/identity.mjs). `same_model` maps a name to the model it is: an effort or thinking variant, a lane or route name, or an alias. `model_lab` declares the lab of models that models.json and lanes.json do not themselves declare. `routes` are vendors that can serve models of several labs: the lab of a model reached through one is never taken from the route. A cycle opened under pantheon.cycle/v3 carries the whole policy built from these files, so editing them never changes how a recorded cycle verifies.

claude-opus-4-6-thinking.basis: the agy lane name for claude-opus-4-6 with thinking enabled: an effort setting, not another model (config/lanes.json)

gemini-3.8-flash-high.basis: the name `agy models` prints for gemini-3.8-flash at high thinking; the API model is gemini-3.8-flash (config/lanes.json basis)
